selection_rules: finite PHAFSTHR and PHAFSTMN, 0 <= PHAFSTMN < 60, 8.5 <= PHAFSTHR + PHAFSTMN/60 < 24
finite WTSAF2YR from INS_I and WTSAF2YR > 0; GLU_I weight must agree
exclude RIDEXPRG == 1; females aged 20-44 must have RIDEXPRG == 2; retain older females with public pregnancy-ascertainment limitation
DIQ050 == 2; exclude reported insulin use, refusal, don't know and missing
finite RIDAGEYR, BMXBMI and LBXGLU; RIAGENDR in {1,2}
finite LBXIN (including CDC below-LOD substituted measurements); no target-magnitude filter
detection_limit_policy: Preserve CDC LBXIN values as released, including LLOD/sqrt(2) fill values; retain LBDINLC in custodian reference. LLOD is 1.0 uU/mL per INS_I metadata. No extra imputation.
pregnancy_limitation: Pregnancy status is publicly released only for women 20-44. Those women require RIDEXPRG=2. Older women are retained unless recorded pregnant, but complete nonpregnancy cannot be established from public files.
insulin_use_handling: DIQ050=2 is required. Yes, refusal, do not know and missing are excluded. This is self-report, not verification of medication administration.
fasting_definition: PHAFSTHR + PHAFSTMN/60 from FASTQX_I; morning is PHDSESN=0. Additional intake questions are not used as extra exclusions; reported food-fast duration and positive official fasting weight define this protocol.
homair_policy: Any HOMA-IR is a downstream algebraic derivation from generated insulin and observed glucose, never an independently measured validation truth.
glucose_policy: Use released LBXGLU mg/dL as-is. CDC already harmonized the minority of C501 measurements forward to C311; do not apply a second instrument correction.
freshness_status: No 2015-2016 insulin-specific filename or selected protocol metadata detected in the bounded local inventory. Historical independence is unproven; this is not certified clean or unexposed.

excluded_cohorts: National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey

source_packet_status: Prepared separately; no approvals created here
validation_scope: Task schema and visible serialized input validated by existing cohort_harness.contracts. No generator run or target evaluation.
